prompt: Slow cinematic aerial shot. The foreground paraglider with a bright red and yellow canopy drifts smoothly to the right, the fabric rippling gently in the wind. Background paragliders glide at different altitudes, slowly shifting positions against the mountainous coastline. The turquoise water below shimmers with subtle light reflections. A gentle forward dolly camera movement creates depth as hazy mountains recede into the distance. Clear blue sky, warm afternoon light, photorealistic.

A cinematic slow dolly-out from a tall green cable car tower as two cable cars glide smoothly along steel cables against a vivid blue sky. In the foreground, vibrant pink-red flowers sway gently in a warm breeze. Sunlight glints off the cables and car windows. The camera pulls back and tilts upward, revealing the full scenic landscape. Golden hour lighting, shallow depth of field on flowers, smooth continuous motion. 4K, photorealistic.

Cinematic close-up of a barista in a blue denim apron hand-brewing coffee in a warm, cozy café. Slow-motion shots of coffee beans being ground in a black manual grinder, hot water spiraling over pour-over grounds, rich dark coffee dripping into a clear glass carafe. Hero shot of a hand lifting the glass carafe filled with dark amber coffee, light refracting through the glass. Concludes with a smooth pour into a ceramic cup, steam rising, warm golden-hour lighting throughout, shallow depth of field, 4K cinematic quality, mahogany and amber color palette.
